stemMd: A seller's profit is 30% of selling price. What is profit as a percentage of cost?
explanationMd: Take selling price as 100. Profit is 30 and cost 70, so profit/cost is 30/70=3/7. As a percentage that is 300/7%, approximately 42.86%.

distractorRationale.b: This retains the selling-price base instead of switching to cost.
distractorRationale.e: This is cost as a percentage of selling price.
distractorRationale.c: This treats the margin as a cost markup.
distractorRationale.a: This multiplies proportions instead of taking their ratio.
